images.caption: Jamie Cope, Executive Director, University of Charleston Downtown Innovation Hub, facilitates the Manufacturing Roundtable. Charleston, WV (March 12, 2026) - USDA Rural Business & Cooperative Programs Administrator J.R. Claeys visits West Virginia to highlight manufacturing, economic development, and domestic energy production. Joined by State Director John Reisenweber, Claeys announced $294.2 million invested across West Virginia communities, supporting 28 rural community projects, 31 economic development and agribusiness projects, and $175 million for affordable housing. During his visit, Claeys participated in a manufacturing leadership roundtable in Charleston, toured Eagle Summit East’s coal mining facility, and met with Partner Community Capital and local businesses to discuss job creation and rural investment. USDA Photo by James Pinsky
